forceNightlightOff.title: Force Nightlight Off
forceNightlightOff.description: No mood lighting, please. Pura normally syncs the nightlight with the diffuser. Turn this on to keep the nightlight off while the diffuser is running.

enableFanService.title: Enable Intensity Control
enableFanService.description: Because “on” and “off” aren’t enough choices. Replaces the on/off switch with a fan control for choosing Subtle, Medium, or Strong intensity. On multi-bay diffusers, intensity changes apply across available bays to keep auto-alternate working as expected.

enableBayControl.title: Enable Per-Bay Controls
enableBayControl.description: For those who like to pick favorites. Gives each fragrance bay its own HomeKit control. With Intensity Control enabled, each bay appears as a fan; otherwise, it appears as a switch. On diffusers that only run one bay at a time, turning one bay on turns the other off.

enableNightlightAccessory.title: Enable Nightlight Controls
enableNightlightAccessory.description: Set the vibe along with the scent. Adds HomeKit controls for the nightlight, including On/Off, Brightness, and Color, on compatible diffusers.

enableAutoAlternate.title: Enable Auto-Alternate Control
enableAutoAlternate.description: Can’t pick a favorite? Let Pura play referee. Adds a HomeKit switch for Pura’s Auto-Alternate setting on multi-bay diffusers. When on, Pura rotates between fragrance bays over time; when off, it sticks with the bay you choose. Either way, only one bay diffuses at a time.
